svgCleaner.title: SVG Cleaner & Optimizer
svgCleaner.description: Clean and optimize SVG files by removing redundant code, comments, metadata, and unnecessary attributes. Perfect for cleaning SVG files exported from Figma, Sketch, Adobe Illustrator, or other design tools.
svgCleaner.shortDescription: Clean and optimize SVG files (remove comments, metadata, editor data)
svgCleaner.longDescription: This powerful SVG optimization tool helps you clean up SVG files exported from design tools like Figma, Sketch, and Adobe Illustrator. Remove unnecessary metadata, editor-specific data (Inkscape, Illustrator, Sketch), comments, hidden elements, empty containers, and redundant attributes. With dozens of configurable optimization options, you can significantly reduce SVG file size while maintaining visual quality. Supports both SVGO browser-based optimization and fallback cleanup methods.
